CARDAT Data Access Request Form

Please ensure when submitting the data access request form that you:

  • Include key members of your project team, for example:
    • project lead
    • supervisor(s), if a student
    • data analysts or curators who will also be handling the data
  • Provide a reasonably detailed description of your project, including:
    • Spatial and temporal extent and resolution
    • Key datasets you will be using
    • Specific outcomes
